your_games.title: 🏆 GTA VI leads The Game Awards 2026 nominations with eight
your_games.body: Rockstar's game is up for Game of the Year two days before it launches, alongside 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem and Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Nintendo is the most-nominated publisher with 12 nods, including Pokémon Pokopia twice. For your games, The Witcher 3 is up for Best Ongoing Game and Best Community Support, Helldivers 2 for Best Community Support, The Blood of Dawnwalker for Best RPG and Best Narrative, and Pokémon Champions for Best Mobile Game. The nominations also confirmed Manni L. Perez as Lucia. Fan voting is open until 9 December, and the show airs on 10 December.

your_games.title: 💿 GTA VI won't run until you install the latest PS5 system update
your_games.body: PlayStation Support says firmware 14.23.00 is required to play GTA VI and should be installed before midnight on 19 November, when the game unlocks. It's a 1.3GB download. Sony normally gives a grace period before an update becomes mandatory, but it's tightening security after recent PS5 hacks.

your_games.title: 🧛 The Blood of Dawnwalker's New Game+ update is out now
your_games.body: Update 1.2 has landed a few days early on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC. New Game+ keeps your level, skills and inventory, raises the level cap to 100, scales every region to you, and adds NG+ gear with new stats. It also tweaks health pools for level 17 to 30 enemies and fixes terrain geometry. The Xbox version is 20% off in the Black Friday sale.

your_games.title: 🥚 Pocketpair holds back Palworld 1.1 and Palfarm news during GTA VI week
your_games.body: Asked about Palworld 1.1 and Palfarm, Pocketpair's head of communications John Buckley said sharing news the week GTA VI drops is "probably not the best idea" from a PR point of view. Expect updates once the launch week has passed, but there's no new date yet.

your_games.title: 🥊 Pokémon Champions gets a balance patch on 2 December
your_games.body: The update gives new moves to several Pokémon, including Play Rough for all the Eeveelutions and Roost for Beedrill and Hydreigon. Screech, Steel Wing, Metal Sound and Frost Breath become fully accurate, Rock Slide gets more accurate but flinches less often, and Flash Fire and Stalwart are reworked.

your_games.title: 🌅 Sea of Stars gets a Switch 2 Sunset Edition with all its DLC on the cartridge
your_games.body: iam8bit's final Sea of Stars collection includes a $49.99 Switch 2 physical with the full game and every expansion on the cartridge, plus a soundtrack code. Exclusive and $129.99 Collector's Editions add more extras. Pre-orders are open until 11 January and copies ship on 2 April 2027.

your_games.title: 🏴‍☠️ Sea of Thieves almost halves its install size on Thursday
your_games.body: Rare's 19 November update cuts the game from over 100GB to 56.4GB on Xbox Series X, and to about 25GB on Series S and Xbox One. PS5 and PC also get smaller installs, alongside bug fixes. Handy if you're making room for GTA VI.

your_games.title: 🐉 Spyro: A Realm Beyond will show more at The Game Awards
your_games.body: Activision and Toys for Bob shared the first in-game screenshots of the Painted Plains area and promised more on 10 December. It's the first all-new Spyro adventure in nearly 20 years, due in spring 2027.

your_games.title: 🗡️ Final Fantasy XIV offers lapsed players 30 free days before Evercold
your_games.body: If you haven't logged in for six months, you can get 30 days of free game time. Characters at level 90 or above can instead skip to the final part of Dawntrail. Evercold launches in February.

industry.title: Firaxis lays off a third of its staff as studio head Heather Hazen leaves
industry.body: Bloomberg reports that around 60 people have lost their jobs at the 2K-owned Civilization and XCOM studio. 2K says Firaxis is "restructuring and recentering" around strategy games. Bloomberg also reports that a new XCOM has struggled and missed a milestone over the summer, though development continues.

industry.title: Sony beats the £2 billion UK lawsuit over PlayStation Store prices
industry.body: The Competition Appeal Tribunal rejected Alex Neill's class action for about 12.2 million players, which claimed Sony shut out competition and charged "excessive and unfair" prices. The tribunal found Sony competes in a wider market with Xbox, Nintendo and PC, and that buyers can make informed choices when they pick a console.

industry.title: PlayStation has no Game of the Year nominee for the first time since 2014
industry.body: Sony-published games had been nominated every year since Bloodborne in 2015, and three of them won. This year Saros, Marvel Tokon and Wolverine all missed the shortlist, though PlayStation still has nine nominations across other categories.

industry.title: Xbox's Black Friday sale starts at 07:00 SAST on 20 November
industry.body: Microsoft promises up to 80% off more than 2,000 games, including Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade at 80% off and Forza Horizon 6 Premium Edition at 25% off, plus accessory deals. Game Pass also adds nine games between now and 1 December, led by Arkheron, The Outlast Trials and Hela: Of Mice & Magic.
